records.name: Main story
records.summary: Kliff's campaign: a prologue, twelve chapters and an epilogue, played in a fixed order.
records.body: Sources count about 168 main-quest steps across the fourteen sections. The campaign is linear with a single ending; some chapters permanently change the world state, which is recorded under points of no return as they are confirmed.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list
